overall_strategy_summary: Barclays operates across UK retail banking, US/UK investment banking, and wealth management. Digital asset activity: UK Finance GBTD pilot, Ubyx stablecoin settlement investment, 10-bank stablecoin consortium participation, Ryan Hayward as Head of Digital Assets. Previously restricted retail crypto via credit cards. Broader strategy: investment banking growth (US focused), UK retail transformation, cost efficiency, and strategic review completion. Technology investment in trading platforms, digital banking, and risk management.
